agency: Port Alder Department of Human Services (DHS)
extra_person_rule: For households larger than 8, add 8% of the 4-person limit per additional person.
common_documents: Photo ID for the applicant (national ID card or passport)
Proof of Port Alder address dated within the last 60 days (lease, utility bill or official letter)
National ID numbers for all household members (birth certificates for children without an ID)
Proof of all household income for the last 30 days (pay stubs, pension statement, benefit award letters or self-employment ledger)

programs.name: Alder Food Assist
programs.summary: Monthly food benefit loaded on the Alder Assist card.
extra_documents: Most recent bank statement (used for the expedited-service test)

programs.name: Utility Relief Credit
programs.summary: 30% credit on the water, sewer and trash bill, capped at $45 per month.
extra_documents: Most recent water/sewer bill in the applicant's name, or a lease showing utilities are included in rent

programs.name: Rental Bridge Assistance
programs.summary: One-time payment of up to 3 months of rent (max $4,500) paid directly to the landlord to prevent eviction.
extra_documents: Eviction notice or landlord's statement of rent arrears
Landlord payment form (completed by the landlord: tax ID and bank details)
Proof of living in Port Alder for at least 6 months

programs.name: Child Care Subsidy
programs.summary: Pays licensed child care for children under 13 (under 18 with a disability) while parents work or study at least 20 hours a week.
extra_documents: Employer letter or work schedule (or school/training enrolment) showing at least 20 hours a week
Birth certificate for each child in care
Licensed provider's enrolment form with licence number

programs.name: Senior & Disability Transit Pass
programs.summary: Monthly transit pass for $5 instead of $68 for residents aged 65+ or with a certified disability; free for AFA households.
extra_documents: Proof of age (ID) or disability certification (form DHS-DC1 signed by a licensed clinician, or national disability card)

missing_documents: Proof of income for the last 30 days (pay stubs from Bayview Grocers)
Water/sewer bill showing the service address (for URC)
applications.notes: Interview completed 2026-10-28. If documents are not received by the due date the application is denied for missing information; the applicant can reapply at any time.
Pass card mailed 2026-11-03; activate at any ticket machine or on the transit app.
All documents received including the landlord payment form. Decision expected by 2026-11-13; if approved, payment goes to the landlord within 5 business days.

applications.denial_reason: Household income $5,120/month is above the 85% AMI limit for 2 people ($4,987/month).
applications.notes: Appeal in writing within 30 days of the notice; a change in income (e.g. reduced hours) can be reported as a new application.
